Location: HIGH COURT OF KARNATAKA  THIS WRIT PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227  OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA, PRAYING TO DIRECT THE Manikappa vs The State Of Karnataka on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63101338/
1  RESPONDENT TO CONSIDER THE REPRESENTATION DAT  19.10.2022 AS PER ANNEXURES-B AND B1 IN RESPECT   PROPERTY OF THE PETITIONER AND ETC.
 THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING,
 THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC-K:5474  WP No. 201926 of 2023  ORDER 1.
Learned High Court Government Pleader accepts notice for the respondent.

2. The petitioner is before this Court seeking for the following reliefs:
a. Issue writ of mandamus directing the respondent to consider the representation dated 19.10.2022 as per Annexures-B and B1 in respect of property of the petitioner,
in the interest of justice and equity.
b. Issue any writ or order or directions as this Hon'ble Court deems fit in circumstances of the case, in ends of justice and equity.
3.

The grievance of the petitioner is that though enhanced compensation has been paid as regards similarly situated land acquired under the very same notification, the said enhanced compensation has not been made available to the petitioner.

4. Whenever any land is acquired and compensation is enhanced, it is required that all the land losers also be made available the same compensation as held by NC: 2023:KHC-K:5474 this Court in MSA.No.200186/2019 disposed of on 11.02.2021.
5.

In that view of the matter, I pass the following:
ORDER i. The Writ Petition is allowed.
ii. A mandamus is issued directing the respondent to consider the representations of the petitioner dated 19.10.2022 at Annexures-B and B1 by treating the same as an application under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act.
Sd/-
JUDGE NB Manikappa vs The State Of Karnataka on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63101338/
